messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

The missing SIM card is definitely the root cause of your no-signal issue—and without cellular service, MMS won't work. Reseating the SIM card is a safe, non-destructive step that won't affect your photos, contacts, or personal data. It simply means removing and reinserting the SIM card to ensure it's properly connected.

Please run `reseat_sim_card()` on your phone. After it completes, wait a moment for the phone to recognize the SIM card, then run `check_sim_status()` again and share the results with me.

I have reseated the SIM card, and now my phone shows the SIM card is active and working. The status bar shows a poor signal with 2G network, but mobile data is still disabled. What should I do next to fix the MMS issue?

Please perform the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
